identificationModule.briefTitle: Phase I/II Study of SCTB39-1 in Advanced Solid Tumours
identificationModule.officialTitle: An Open Multi-center Phase I/II Study to Evaluate the Safety, Tolerability, Pharmacokinetics and Preliminary Efficacy of SCTB39-1 in Adult Patients With Advanced Malignant Solid Tumours

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This study aims to evaluate the safety, tolerability, PK characteristics, immunogenicity, and preliminary anti-tumor efficacy of SCTB39-1 as a monotherapy in adult patients with advanced malignant solid tumours. This study is an open label, multicentre, dose-escalation and dose-expansion Phase I/II clinical trial.

armGroups.label: SCTB39-1
armGroups.description: SCTB39-1 of different doses, IV, every 3 weeks

primaryOutcomes.description: Incidence of dose-limiting toxicities up to the Day 21 visit
The ORR is defined as the proportion of subjects with confirmed CR or confirmed PR, based on RECIST Version 1.1.

secondaryOutcomes.description: The DCR is defined as the proportion of subjects with CR, PR, or SD based on RECIST Version 1.1.
Progression-free survival is defined as the time from the start of treatment with SCTB39-1 until the first documentation of disease progression or death due to any cause, whichever occurs first.
Overall survival is defined as the time from the start of treatment with SCTB39-1 until death due to any cause.
